integrity: Standalone finite consistency programs and their exact run output accompany the mathematical proof; no independent validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Only the standard regular cyclic tournaments and the oriented triangle source are classified; no equivariant action or arbitrary tournament classification is asserted. The infinite theorem has a complete poset-fiber and nerve proof. An unindexed equivalent result may exist.
title: The directed triangle Hom complex of every regular cyclic tournament has the homotopy type of a circle
